text: 19 Avni : Nani, shall we go to the park? Nani : Sure. You need to complete your homework first, don’t you? Avni : Yes, Nani. I have completed my homework. Nani : Very good Avni. Let’s go to the park. (Nani and Avni go to the park.) Avni : Hurry up Nani. Look at my friends. They are playing near the slide. Can I play with them? Nani : Sure dear. You can play with your friends. Avni : Ok. Thank you, Nani. 1. Look, read and talk about the picture. Avni’s Visit to a Park 2.2
